facts.material: laminate of BOPP (polypropylene) and PET (polyester) films

gri_path: GRI 1: heading 3920 plastic film not laminated with other materials, or 3921
GRI 3(b): plastic-to-plastic laminate needs the layer giving essential character

rejected_alternatives.reason: J80001 laminate included aluminum; a plastic-only laminate stays in 3920 unless other material is present

missing_facts: Which layer predominates by weight or thickness (PET or polypropylene)?
Is there any metallized or other non-plastic layer or coating?
Is it printed, and what is its thickness?
classification.rationale: The 6-digit subheading depends on which plastic gives essential character, so the code cannot be chosen without layer proportions.
